decisions.reason: The client ends the task broadly, which may require removing this active task-local obligation rather than modifying its wording attributes; the permitted propagated MODIFY cannot safely represent that lifecycle effect.

The task-wide termination may remove this active task-local messaging obligation, but it does not entail any change to the existing benefit and claim values that could be represented by a propagated MODIFY.

Leaving the video-production task may remove this active task-local visual obligation, but the source does not modify its visual-style or realism attributes; representing the impact would require a lifecycle decision.
The audit was already deferred and may be outside the video task being terminated; it is unclear whether the client also cancels this separate postponed obligation.
